FC620 / FC660: Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Molded Base
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/norix-fc620-fc660-forte-lounge-chair-with-molded-base-n700154
Manufacturer page: https://norix.com/product/forte-lounge-arm-chairs/
Spec sheets: FC620 / FC660 Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Molded Base, Forté Brochure
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Molded Plinth Base – FC620 / FC660
Current H1: Norix Forté Durable Lounge Chair with Molded Base - FC620 / FC660
Subtitle: Rotationally Molded Lounge Arm Chair on a Ballastable Plinth Base, with Optional Upholstery, for Lounges and Dayrooms
Current subtitle: Norix Furniture Forté Series FC620 Forté Lounge Chair with FC660 Molded Plinth Base
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Molded Base pairs a one-piece, rotationally molded lounge chair (FC620) with a molded plinth base (FC660). It brings a comfortable, residential look to lounges and dayrooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities, and the arms give residents hand-over-ankle positioning for easier egress.
The anti-ligature design has no internal openings. Molded-in steel threaded inserts let you gang chairs side by side or with Forté occasional tables, a push-in cap seals the port for up to 100 lbs of dry sand or gravel ballast, and an optional bolt-down kit anchors the chair to the floor. An optional upholstered shell adds cushioning.
Construction: One-piece, rotationally molded high-impact polyethylene with UV stabilizers and a lightly textured, maintenance-free surface
Ligature Resistant: Anti-ligature design with no internal openings
TruColor Polymer: Fully compounded color for consistent color and durability
Chemical Resistance: Resists blood, vinegar, urine, feces, salt solution, and chlorine solution
Ganging and Ballast: Molded-in steel threaded inserts for optional side-to-side ganging, and a push-in cap that seals the ballast port
Optional Upholstery: Factory-installed upholstered plywood shell with polyurethane foam on the seat and back, double stitched with concealed staples; it can be removed for cleaning or replacement
Overall Size: 27”W×30.9”D×32.6”H
Seat: 18” seat height and 21.9” seat width, with a 26” arm height
Weight: 44 lbs
Seat Colors: Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, or Dove; extended colors Citrus, Tranquil, Malibu, Cobalt, Wisteria, LUX Ivory, and LUX Onyx have a 6-piece minimum per color
Base Colors: Sienna, Dove, or Raven
Static Load Testing: Tested to 750 lbs
Performance Standards: Dynamic drop tested to twice the ANSI/BIFMA X5.4 impact force (250 lbs from 18”)
Flammability Standards (Not Upholstered): California Technical Bulletins 133 and 117; UL 1056; ASTM E1537; NFPA 261; UL 94 HB; BS 7176:2007 high hazard
Flammability Standards (Upholstered): California Technical Bulletin 117, with an optional TB133 upholstery upgrade
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold
Cleaning: Simple Green or a similar cleaner for routine cleaning; bleach and water solutions and hospital-grade disinfectants such as Virex, Wexcide, or Oxivir Five 16 can be used per the manufacturer’s instructions; follow the fabric maker’s instructions for upholstery
Warranty: 10-year limited replacement warranty
Intended Use: Indoor use only
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
FC620 / FC660 – Not Upholstered: Lounge arm chair on a molded plinth base, 44 lbs
FC620 / FC660 – Upholstered (COM): Upholstered shell in customer’s own material (1.15 yards of fabric)
Options: Ganging kit (C011-016), bolt-down kit (C011-026), factory ballasting (50 lbs), and TB133 upholstery upgrade
Installation and Options
Assembly: None required
Ganging: Installation required for ganging plates
Bolt-Down: The bolt-down kit for the plinth base must be specified when ordering
Ballast: Can be ballasted on site with up to 100 lbs of dry sand or gravel (not supplied by Norix), or factory ballasted with 50 lbs
[H2] Applications
The Norix Forté Lounge Arm Chair with Molded Base suits lounges and dayrooms where residents need a comfortable chair that is safe and hard to move or throw.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, lounges, and activity rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Lobbies, waiting rooms, and visitation areas
Dayrooms and visitation rooms in correctional and detention facilities
Transitional housing and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture, Prison and Detention Furniture, and Transitional Housing Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Norix Forté Furniture
Norix Forté is a designer series of seating and tables that brings comfort and a less institutional look to intensive-use rooms in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. The chairs and molded bases are rotationally molded from high-impact polyethylene with Norix TruColor polymer, and many pieces can be ballasted, bolted down, or ganged together.
The Forté series includes:
Guest Chairs: Guest arm and armless chairs, with or without upholstery
Lounge Chairs: Lounge arm and armless chairs on a molded plinth base or a solid hardwood base, with or without upholstery
Café Tables: A 36” round molded table, 42” and 48” round and 42” square laminate tops, and a 42” square DuoForm top, all on a molded hourglass base
Occasional Tables: 27” square laminate-top tables on a molded or wood base, which can be ganged with lounge chairs as intermediate or corner tables
[H2] About Norix Furniture
Norix manufactures durable furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, police stations, correctional institutions, and residential treatment centers. Explore the full line of Norix Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: same "About Norix Forté Furniture" section as the FC600 tab.
PHOTOS: all 3 chair photos on our page show the ARMLESS lounge chair (Norix FC630), not the FC620 arm chair. Norix has FC620 arm chair photos on the molded base (600×600): Twilight/Raven, Sand/Raven, Sand/Sienna, Sage/Sienna, Clay/Sienna, and Cove/Dove. Would you like me to replace the armless photos with these, or add them and keep the old ones?
Colors: the current page lists the seat colors as "Twilight, Sage, Clay, Sienna, Dove, Raven," which mixes seat and base colors. The price list and spec sheet give seat colors Twilight, Cove, Sage, Clay, Sand, and Dove, and base colors Sienna, Dove, and Raven. Corrected.
Prices checked: $956.80 (not upholstered) and $1,370.40 (upholstered, COM) are 80% of the Norix list prices of $1,196 and $1,713 (compare-at $1,196 and $1,713). No change.
Upholstered variant: our page sells only the COM version. The price list also has fabric grades B through H ($1,743 to $1,926 list). Would you like those as variants? If yes, please give me the SKUs.
Options: the price list shows the ganging kit (C011-016) at $83, the bolt-down plate (C011-026) at $87, factory ballasting (50 lbs) at $84, and the TB133 upholstery upgrade at $112 (list). They are in the text but are not variants. Would you like any of them as variants?
Weight and size match the spec sheet and the worksheet (rows 197-198: 44 / 30.9 / 27 / 32.6).
Meta title: "with Molded Base" did not fit with "at Anchortex," so the meta title uses the model numbers to tell it apart from the wood base chair.
Collections: the chair is already in Behavioral Healthcare, Prison and Detention Furniture, Transitional Housing, and Norix Furniture. I added a Transitional Housing Furniture link, since all seven Forté products are in that collection.
Removed: the long old series paragraph and the long old "About Norix Furniture" paragraph; replaced with the new Forté section and the standard paragraph used on all Norix pages.
